chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washa, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about a man who dies and upon him is a debt [of fasting] from the month of Ramadan. Who should pay it off on his behalf? He said: The closest of the people to him. I said: And if the closest of the people to him was a woman? He said: No, except the men.

key_terms.دَيْنٌ: debt (specifically of fasting in this context)

ai.seo_question: Who is responsible for making up the fasting debts of a deceased person, and does gender matter?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the specific gender restriction in the obligation of Qada al-Siyam (making up fasts) for the deceased, distinguishing it from other debts where women may also be liable. It highlights the juristic consensus in Shia tradition that the physical act of fasting is primarily incumbent upon male heirs, reflecting the distinct legal capacities assigned to men and women in ritual obligations.

en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali AL Washa, from Hammad Bin Usman, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the man who dies and upon him are debts from a Month of Ramazan. Who should make up for these on his behalf?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The closest of the people to him’. I said, ‘And if it was such that the closest of the people to him was a woman?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, except the men’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-Washsha’ from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from those whom he has mentioned who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who dies and owes fast of the month of Ramadan and about who is responsible to complete its Qada’ (compensatory fast) on his behalf. He (the Imam) said, ‘The one who has the greatest degree of priority in the matter about him completes Qada’ (compensatory fast) on his behalf.’ I then asked, ‘Can such person be a woman?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘No, such person can only be from men.’”
